To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
(1) The zeros of a network of linear multi-agent system can be characterized by the zeros of individual agents and the zeros of the interconnection dynamics.

the zero set of a network of linear multi-agent dynamical systems is a union of the zero sets of its interconnection dynamics, its individual agents, and the zero set of the union of the individual agent zeros, and that the zero set can be modified by blocking the interconnections between the agents.

the zero properties of a network of linear multi-agent system are determined by the zero properties of each individual agent, the zero properties of interconnection dynamics, and the number of agents that are blocked from each other.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions.
the zeros of linear multi-agent networks and the effects of interconnection dynamics and blocking.
the following three aspects: (i) zero characterization for heterogeneous networks; (ii) zero characterization for homogeneous networks, and (iii) the effects of blocking.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, for a homogeneous network, the zeros of the whole network are determined by the interconnection topology and the interconnection dynamics.
, the zero properties of a network are determined by the zeros of the individual agents as well as the interconnection dynamics.
the zeros of a network can be obtained from the zeros of each agent and interconnection dynamics, and blocking does not affect the zeros of a system.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the zeros of networks of linear agents are the zeros of each agent and the zeros of the interconnection dynamics.
the zeros of the networks of linear multi-agents are characterized by the zeros of each individual agents and the zeros of interconnection matrices.
we have provided a complete picture of how the zeros of the network are determined by the zeros of the individual agents, the interconnection dynamics and the interconnection topology.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the network zero properties are closely related to the interconnection dynamics.
, in order to achieve a desired zero dynamics, one can design a network with a specific structure and/or interconnection dynamics.
the zeros are not only affected by the individual dynamics of the agents but also by the interconnection dynamics.
